title: Things 3.23 update now available with major repeating to-do improvements - 9to5Mac
summary: Things is making repeating to-dos significantly more flexible in version 3.23, addressing two common situations: finishing a task ahead of schedule and changing its date when plans shift. Available now, Things 3.23 gives repeating to-dos ordinary checkboxes.
